prose: Beth Martens returns to help us navigate the difficult pressures and tyrannies being imposed by employers and governments, and to tell us of her experiences with the Manitobastan medico-mafia. Legal empowerment, resisting the Delta Scare-iant scams, and big tech censorship are just a few of the topics on our agenda for this livestream.
